subject: IW2591
content:
In all kinds of relaxing hobbies among teenagers, playing online games or mobile-phone games are the most popular ones of them, and teens often spend one to four hours on them. In my opinion, the benefits of playing games are that one can relax, leaving all the frustrating things in daily life behind, when playing them. That's the reason of many people take "I just want to relax", as an excuse when they want to play games. The second advantage of playing games is for making friends. Though playing games that have multi-players in it, one can easily create teams with other players, sometimes their friends, classmates or relatives, and sometimes strangers online. Because of this reason, old friends connect with each other stronger, and new friends know more each other though this hobby. The third is for honnoress. When one leveled-up or got rare items in a game, they would feel proud of themselves because of their hard-work in games. This makes them feel better than others, and makes them want to play harder.
Though there are many benifits of playing games, there are also many disadvantages. For example, playing games too much may hurt one's sight, especially teenagers. A reaserch shows, over seventy percentage of students have the problem of short-eyesight, that makes them need to wear glasses which I feel uncomfortable. Second, one may cannot leave the game easily and become grumpy. In my experiences, games often encourages players to continue playing by giving daily-checks or missions that often come one after another, and they often give you rich gifts when you finish them. This makes players want to complete them and keep playing for a long time. At that time, when your parents or someone else tells you to stop playing, you may feel mad and think, "Why are you telling me to stop?" because you haven't finish the mission the game gives you, then you may have argument with your parents. The third shortpoint of games is you need to pay in the game. Sometimes, games will want to pay when you want to unlock more functions or get something you're willing to own. If one can't control their mind, they may pay a lot of money to the game company to buy something not real. I think this is a waste, though I had this kind of experience. At that time, I paid for remote-raid passes when the game is having an annaversary activiy, that the raid boss is something I'm willing for a long time. Thinking about it now, I think I shouldn't make that exchange.
To sum up, games may make one relax, feel honor, and make friends, but also may cost you an arm and a leg. Because of the reason, I think we can play games, but not too often, also not to be affected by the rare or rich items in the game. Like me, I always make agreements with my parents about the time I play games in a day, and also not to pay in games, so I can enjoy the happiness of playing games with friends and relatives, and don't need to worry about the disadvantages that games give me because I've already avoid them. If you play games in this way, you'll be not only a healthy but also a joyful player like me.
